breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the flexural second moment with a polar moment in the curvature relation, even though beam bending curvature is governed by M/(E I).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated to use the polar second moment of area (J) in the curvature relation. The generated specification correctly ignored this and used the standard formula for beam bending curvature, κ = M / (E × I), which aligns with the ground truth prompt.
